headline: Indian Card Clothing Company provides clarification on its October 20, 2026 board meeting outcome
hook: Clarification issued on recent board outcome
summary: Indian Card Clothing Company Limited has submitted a clarification to the stock exchanges regarding the outcome of its board meeting held on October 20, 2026. Routine regulatory filings of this nature help ensure corporate transparency and compliance. Such procedural updates generally have negligible direct impact on broader market sentiment or stock price movement. Retail investors holding the stock should note the filing as part of routine corporate disclosures.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no material impact on share price.

headline: Indian Card Clothing appoints Tushar Arvind Vaidya as Non-Independent Non-Executive Director
hook: New board seat at Indian Card
summary: Indian Card Clothing Company Limited announced the appointment of Tushar Arvind Vaidya as a Non-Independent Non-Executive Director. The appointment is effective from October 20, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing regarding board composition changes. For Indian retail investors, routine board appointments of micro-cap companies have minimal immediate impact on stock prices.
why_it_matters: Routine board changes rarely move micro-cap stock prices.
